summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K on April 28, 2026, reporting a trading update for the first quarter ended April 3, 2026, and declaring an interim dividend. The filing presents financial metrics including revenue, volume growth, and alternative performance measures, with comparable group volume growth of 1.6%. No special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes are discussed. The update is a routine quarterly operational and financial report.
